title: Create, route, and retain a Salesforce support case
userStory: As a support agent, I want to create a case, assign its priority and owner, and move it into active work so the support team can track and act on the request accurately.
businessRequirements: Proposed rules require business owner confirmation: a new Case uses New; active work uses Working; the proposed priority is Medium and proposed owner is Synthetic Queue. Subject is required. The designated read-only persona may view eligible Cases but cannot create or update Cases. These are proposed requirements, not Salesforce defaults or existing-org claims. The configured test org may require additional fields; their synthetic values must be agreed before execution.
assumptions: An authorized nonproduction org, configured queue, confirmed role permissions and approved credential references are prerequisites; none is supplied or connected by this demo. All test data is synthetic. The fixture demonstrates test authoring only; Salesforce tests are NOT RUN. Proposed Priority Medium and Owner Synthetic Queue require explicit owner confirmation before execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating the synthetic case saves its subject with New status and creates exactly one Case record.
Updating the Case to Working saves the clarified priority and owner without creating another case.
Closing and reopening the saved Case record displays the same Case identifier, Subject, Status, Priority, and Owner; reopening the record does not create another Case.
Saving a new Case with a blank Subject is rejected with a clear Subject validation message, and no Case is created.
A designated read-only tester can view eligible Cases but cannot create a Case or update an existing Case; denied attempts leave Case records unchanged.
